_comment: ALL balance numbers live here. Edit freely, re-run. Per design brief §10.
_mandate_target_note: Brief says ~200 for full 5-faction game. Started lower (60) so 1v1 White-vs-Red finishes in ~15-25 turns for fast iteration. Crank up to taste.

turn._max_turns_note: Hard cap to prevent infinite games during bot sweeps.

red.name: The Vanguard
red._recruit_note: Red's Deploy action recruits N soldiers.

white_scoring._bite_note: Each decree in play 'bites' once per turn during White's upkeep. Positive decrees bite if White has any cards in hand (decree benefit being 'used'); negative decrees bite if the target has the taxed resource (the restriction lands). Simplification of the §3 'detached scoring event' for MVP.

red_scoring._knockback_note: Strikes can target opponent's Mandate marker — knocks it back this many points (min 0).

decrees.name: Tax Levy
decrees.text: Each non-White faction pays 1 soldier per turn or loses 1 Mandate.

decrees.name: Civic Endowment
decrees.text: White draws +1 card per turn while in play.

decrees.name: Martial Restraint
decrees.text: Red's strikes cost +1 soldier while in play.

decrees.name: Writ of Order
decrees.text: Opponents' Deploy actions yield -1 unit while in play.

decrees.name: Public Works
decrees.text: When White plays a decree, gain 1 Mandate immediately.

decrees.name: Loyalty Oath
decrees.text: Opponent loses 1 Mandate the turn they play a Research card.

white_deck._note: Multiplicity of decree ids drawn by White. Simple list; shuffled at game start.

bots._policies_note: Trivial heuristics. See bots.py to add more.

_rng_note: null = nondeterministic. Set an int for replayable games.
